final_assessment: Ran a reader probe over the program's four real ledger entries (1 warning, 9 suggestions; every record restatable) and settled the stage's design: the reader runs inside system Pass 4 of the in-context pass over records new since the last reading (D-dr-2, D-dr-8); orbit renders a brief carrying each record's cited texts, area, condition, time and work (D-dr-6); a fourth reader row for a restatement that shifts what it cites (D-dr-7); findings are walked like any other, one replacement per record (D-dr-4); archive records the count of unread records in its run record only, keeping G0 (D-dr-3, D-dr-5, answering a ruling-amendment stop). D-dw-1 is carried in live; D-dw-2 and D-dw-5 are superseded. No open questions; the change is estimated at about five capabilities against a ceiling of three.

residuals.kind: a record written in work no system review cycle reaches, or at a step a later stage adds after the last reading
residuals.method: when a stage adds a step that writes records, its proposal places it against this table; D-dr-3's count surfaces any that reach archive unread

residuals.kind: a reader finding about something other than a record's wording or the brief
residuals.method: classify each reading's findings against this table at its walk; a finding that fits no row is a finding against this rule

residuals.kind: a way a record misleads its reader that none of the six rows names
residuals.method: classify each reading's findings against the rows at its walk (D-dr-4's residual method); a finding that fits none adds a row, as a change to the requirement

residuals.kind: a reader of `decisions/` that a later stage adds and that reads a replaced record as current
residuals.method: when a stage adds a reader of `decisions/`, its proposal checks it against this table; the requirement's named limit says so
